title: Streaming with Kinesis & Amazon MQ
summary: Real-time streaming with Kinesis Data Streams (shards, partition keys, ordering, replay, capacity modes, enhanced fan-out) and near-real-time delivery with Amazon Data Firehose (buffering, Lambda transforms, Parquet conversion, S3/Redshift/OpenSearch/partner destinations). Then how to choose between SQS, SNS and Kinesis, and when Amazon MQ (managed ActiveMQ or RabbitMQ) is the right home for apps that speak AMQP, MQTT, STOMP or OpenWire.
